jobs.description:
Reports to: Middle School Principal
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Duties and Responsibilities: 
Teaching MYP 1 - Grade 6 to MYP 4 - Grade 9, and Primary Grades 4-5 French language acquisition.
Developing materials appropriate for classes with a wide range of abilities.
Contributing to the development and implementation of the curriculum.
Creating and implementing lessons for differentiated skill levels in a classroom.  
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Being an active and contributing member of the school’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 

Qualifications and Experience:
French language teaching qualification.
At least two years of experience as a teacher. 
Preferred experience with IB programmes, MYP or PYP.
Excellent communication skills in English, at a native speaker level.
The ability to establish rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to work effectively in a team.
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently. 
A pleasant and friendly personality.

Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage. In addition, there may be a possibility to increase the employment percentage if a candidate can teach other subjects and take on other responsibilities. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our locations in central Stockholm are easily accessible by public transportation.
Contract:
Employment Type: Parental Leave Replacement
Part-time, 80 %.
Start: January 7th, 2027
End: February 27th, 2027
Salary: Salary scale
Application:
Please email a short statement of interest as well as a current CV to: application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “French teacher Cover 80%”. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. 
Applications will no longer be accepted after November 20th.
SIS reserves the right to close the application process when a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vi söker en engagerad och självgående Facility Coordinator till IES Österåker.

Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerade och närvarande ledare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får du möjlighet att besöka världen fast på hemmaplan. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska.

IES Österåker är en tvåparallellig skola för förskoleklass till årskurs 9 som öppnade i augusti 2024. När skolan är fullbelagd kommer den att rymma ca 600 elever. 

I denna roll kommer du att vara en viktig del av vår dagliga verksamhet och säkerställa att skolans lokaler och miljö håller högsta standard för både elever och personal.

Arbetsuppgifter:

- Ansvara för och sköta om larmet, passersystemet och taggar för säker tillgång till skolans lokaler.
- Du kommer att spela en central roll i det systematiska arbetet med brandskydd och säkerställa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö
- Vara en samordnande kontakt mellan skolan, hyresvärden och andra externa instanser som rör skolans byggnader och anläggningar.
- Utföra mindre vaktmästaruppgifter som underhåll, reparationer och uppsikt av lokaler.
- Värna om vår fina skolgård, säkerställa att den hålls ren och inbjudande.
- Förebygga och lösa praktiska problem som uppstår inom skolans fastigheter och lokaler.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av arbete inom fastighetsförvaltning eller liknande roller, gärna med vaktmästaruppgifter.
- Är tekniskt kunnig, särskilt vad gäller passersystem och brandskydd. Meriterande är om du har genomgått utbildningen för anläggningsskötare. 
- Är organiserad och har förmågan att samarbeta med både interna och externa aktörer.
- Har en god känsla för skolans behov och trivs med att arbeta i en dynamisk och social miljö.
- Är ansvarstagande och noggrann, och har en passion för att vårda vår skolmiljö.

Vi erbjuder:

- En varierande och ansvarsfull roll i en trivsam skolmiljö.
- Möjlighet att vara en central del av skolans arbetslag och bidra till ett positivt arbetsklimat.

Arbeta på en skola med engagerad personal och fantastiska elever.Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100% med provanställning. För mer information om vår skola, vänligen sewww.osteraker.engelska.se Vi ser fram emot din ansökan via IES Careers. Glöm inte att bifoga både CV och personligt brev.Interjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningsperioden gått ut

jobs.occupation: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
jobs.description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!
Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?
Are you passionate about being on camera?
Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:
Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
Free Gym Membership
Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:
Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
Service-minded with good communications skills
A fast-learner
A flexible team player
Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
An entertainer at heart
Excellent customer service skills
Manage Player expectations and behavior
Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.
Send your CV to viktorrecruit@gmail.com
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

 Övrigt: Intyg om legitimation och behörighetsgivande examen ska bifogas ansökan. Registerkontroller görs i samband med anställningen. jobs.occupation: Solution Architect  MES Production Information Labeling
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of software architecture, problem-solving and hands-on collaboration? Join us in shaping digital solutions that support manufacturing on the workshop floor, while taking the architectural lead in building smart and future-ready systems. 
 
About your job 
As Solution Architect for MES Production Information & Labeling, you define and evolve the architecture that brings together the information needed to run manufacturing equipment. Working at both an architectural and technical level, you help transform future needs into scalable, user-friendly solutions. 
 
Job responsibilities 
Design and evolve end-to-end system architectures. 
Define integration strategies, technical standards and architecture across the software stack. 
Participate in the MES architecture forum and establish shared development principles with fellow architects. 
Shape modern solutions using C#, Angular, OAuth 2.0, Kubernetes, pipelines and DevOps practices. 
Guide development teams through design reviews, code reviews and technical coaching. 
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate future needs into sustainable solutions. 

 
Location 
This position is based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden and offers a hybrid work setup, with the possibility to work remotely a couple of days per week. You also spend time close to the workshop environment, where many key interactions take place, and occasional travel may occur. 
 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced software architect with a strong background in software development. Combining architectural thinking with hands-on technical expertise, you build clean, flexible and scalable solutions while supporting development teams in moving from ideas to implementation. 
 
Your background includes 
Solid experience in software architecture and modern distributed systems. 
Strong full-stack development skills and experience guiding development teams. 
Knowledge of DevOps and technologies such as C#, Angular, OAuth 2.0, Kubernetes and pipelines. 
A relevant technical degree. 
Strong communication skills in English. 

 
Curious and collaborative, you combine structure with creativity and enjoy solving complex technical challenges. You communicate clearly, take the lead when needed and help teams move in the same direction. 
 
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

As a trusted specialist, we have extensive knowledge of the regional job market and business community. We combine our experience with a personal and dedicated approach, enabling us to compete successfully with the largest players in the market. We recruit managers and specialists at all levels within Engineering, Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Office Administration. Our operations cover the Skåne region and the Greater Copenhagen area, and our office is centrally located at Gustav Adolfs Torg in Malmö.
 
Finance Manager for a growing manufacturing company - south of Malmö
Are you a skilled finance executive? Would you like to take on a key role in a small and rapidly expanding manufacturing company? Do you also have an eye for details and do you like the idea of products being manufactured in Sweden and sold worldwide? Then this could be your next opportunity!
Our client is an independent Swedish business unit (turn-over 150 MSEK) operating in an international business structure who develops and manufactures at their Swedish site in the Trelleborg area. The company is currently in an exciting development phase and is now looking for a Finance Manager who can take on responsibility for the finance function in Sweden.
This is a broad and hands-on finance management role: you will run the month-end close and personally prepare project costing, over-time revenue recognition, inventory valuation, reconciliations and the Group reporting package, supervising one Finance Assistant. The role works day-to-day with the MD and Project Managers to keep project costs and margins accurate. You will play a key role in supporting the business with financial insight, investment analysis, and decision-making support that drives performance and long-term development.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Project Accounting and Costing
Financial Reporting and Control
Budgeting, Forecasting and Analysis
Cash and Treasury Management (supervising, reviewing)
Support improvement of financial systems and processes
Ensure compliance with tax regulations and applicable financial standards

Your Profile:
You have a relevant degree in e.g. business administration, finance, or accounting and several years of experience in the field. You also have proven experience in a leadership role. You have strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (preferably Microsoft Dynamics BC) is essential.
You have a good understanding of US GAAP and Swedish statutory requirements. Experience from manufacturing or project-based industry is an advantage, as well as experience in a multinational group environment with cross-border reporting responsibilities.
As a person, you are a self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet demanding deadlines. You thrive in a dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with practical implementation. You have a high level of integrity and are a good communicator with excellent leadership skills.
 
About the Position:
This is a permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based south of Malmö.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application in English as soon as possible via the application link. For more information about the role, please contact Karin Dahlin, Standby Workteam, +46 733 76 39 88.

We look forward to your application!

Company Description
IKEA is one of the world's leading home furnishing companies. Our vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible will be able to afford them. The role of IKEA Supply to buy, produce and distribute the IKEA range at the lowest total cost whilst ensuring that the products and services are safe and compliant to the customer under good social and environmental conditions.  
Are you passionate about inspiring a culture where quality is part of everything we do? We are now looking to recruit a Test Specialist, join our Quality Compliance team, based in Älmhult, Sweden. 
Job Description
About the Job 
In this role you are responsible to develop, maintain and ensure the quality and capacity of the external test labs approved by IKEA.
Key Responsibilities 
Responsible for communicating with external test labs about new method approval, updated specifications and IKEA approved lab steering documents
Plan, lead and follow up Lab steering group forum
Being the point of contact for our labs and suppliers when it comes to test information and capacity 
Hand in information from Product Requirements Specialist when new test methods are added or updated in our specifications and present different information in LSG  
Maintenance, update and add information in TRS (Test report system)
Contribute to knowledge sharing with the business team regarding verification testing 
Contribute to the strategy for our external test labs 

Qualifications
About you 
To be successful in this role, you will have: 
Very good knowledge of verification principles and test methods
Good knowledge about Develop Product Requirement process
Knowledge of IKEA values, concepts, directions, strategies and processes
Strong will to secure the prerequisites for safe and compliant products
Solution oriented with the business and customer in focus
Communicate with different target groups internally and externally
Ability to work in a structured way  
An analytical and objective mindset 
Ability to build network and establish trustful relationships, internally and externally 
Ability to communicate and build relationships in a good way 
Ability to work individually, as part of a team and sharing knowledge.  
Goal oriented and ability to prioritize from a business perspective 

Fluent in the English language both spoken and written.
Additional information
We’re excited to learn more about you! Please send us your application (CV + motivation letter) in English as soon as possible, and no later than 20th November 2026. We truly want to get to know you—so tell us: Why do you believe you’re the right fit for this role, what gives you energy and drives your passion, what kind of environment helps you thrive, what are you eager to learn and develop next.  
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in Core Business Supply and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group. 
This is a permanent position based in Älmhult, Sweden—a truly inspirational working environment built on creativity, innovation, and global collaboration. Here, you’ll work alongside passionate people from all over the world. Älmhult offers excellent commuting options, with hourly trains to Malmö, Lund, and Växjö, and an IKEA shuttle bus running to and from Helsingborg twice daily.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
We are now seeking a dedicated Student Care Coordinator (SCC) to help develop our work regarding student safety, a calm learning environment, attendance, and student well-being at IES Upplands Väsby. The position is a full time substitute during a maternity leave. 

Responsibilities:

- Work with the school’s anti-bullying policy.
- Safety and a calm learning environment: Maintain a visible presence within the school and engage in proactive work regarding conflict prevention, the prevention of abusive treatment, and student safety. 
- Student Support: Supporting students facing social, psychosocial, or behavioral challenges through conversations, relationship-building, and individual support interventions.
- School Attendance: Monitoring and analyzing student attendance, identifying concerning absence patterns early, and collaborating with students, guardians, mentors, and the student health team to promote better attendance.
- Active Presence at School: Contributing to a positive school environment by being present during breaks and in common areas.
- Collaboration and Communication: Maintaining a dialogue with guardians and working closely with school staff.

We are looking for someone who is empathetic, organized, and solution-oriented, with a genuine commitment to the safety and development of children and young people. You are skilled at building relationships, handling challenging situations professionally, and able to combine a warm, welcoming approach with clear expectations.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Trygghets- och elevstödsamordnare 

Vi söker nu en engagerad Trygghets- och elevstödsamordnare (engelska: Student Care Coordinator (SCC) som ska vara med och utveckla vårt arbete kring elevtrygghet, en lugn lärmiljö, närvaro och elevers välmående på IES Upplands Väsby. Jobbet är ett vikariat under mammaledighet. 

Ansvarsområden:

- Arbete med skolans plan mot kränkande behandling.
- Trygghet och en lugn lärmiljö: Att vara synlig i skolan och arbeta proaktivt med att förebygga konflikter och kränkningar samt främja elevtryggheten.
- Elevstöd: Att stötta elever som möter sociala, psykosociala eller beteendemässiga utmaningar genom samtal, relationsbyggande och individuella stödinsatser.
- Skolnärvaro: Att följa upp och analysera elevers närvaro, tidigt identifiera oroväckande frånvaromönster samt samarbeta med elever, vårdnadshavare, mentorer och elevhälsoteamet för att främja god närvaro.
- Aktiv närvaro i skolan: Att bidra till en positiv skolmiljö genom att vara närvarande under raster och i gemensamma utrymmen.
- Samarbete och kommunikation: Att ha en dialog med vårdnadshavare och samarbete med skolans personal. 

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, organiserad och lösningsorienterad, med ett genuint engagemang för barns och ungas trygghet och utveckling. Du är skicklig på att bygga relationer, hantera utmanande situationer på ett professionellt sätt och att kombinera ett varmt bemötande med tydliga förväntningar.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.description:
Studie- och yrkesvägledare 50%

Välkommen till vår skola! Internationella Engelska Skolan i Upplands Väsby öppnade dörrarna för våra elever år 2020. Vi är en F-9 skola med ca 600 elever samt ca 65 anställda.  Vi söker nu en utvecklingsinriktad studie- och yrkesvägledare som vill bidra till att våra elevers drömmar och hopp om framtiden blir verklighet. 

Ditt uppdrag som studie- och yrkesvägledare, är att i samarbete med elevhälsoteamet och övrig skolpersonal arbeta hälsofrämjande, förebyggande och åtgärdande med det pedagogiska uppdraget i fokus för att alla elever ska ges förutsättningar att nå utbildningens mål i en miljö som främjar elevernas välmående och lärande. Studie- och yrkesvägledaren har ett särskilt ansvar för att vidga elevernas perspektiv i syfte att eleverna ska kunna fatta väl underbyggda studie- och yrkesval. 

Arbetet innebär bland annat att delta aktivt i elevhälsoteamet och i det kollegiala lärandet. Du håller motiverande och vägledande individuella elevsamtal liksom vägledning i klass eller grupp. Det ingår också att ge information till vårdnadshavare i enskilda samtal eller på föräldramöten. Uppdraget omfattar årskurserna F-9 där arbetet med att leda, systematisera och följa upp prao i årskurs 8 samt gymnasieval i årskurs 9, periodvis är i fokus.

Du omvärldsbevakar och har ett stort intresse i att hålla dig uppdaterad om olika studievägar, utbildningar och rådande läge på arbetsmarknaden. Du är systematisk och utvärderar kontinuerligt kvaliteten i den vägledning som eleverna erbjuds och är väl förtrogen med skolsystemet. Du initierar och samverkar med samverkanspartners inom exempelvis näringslivet.

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som studie- och yrkesvägledare inom grundskola. Du har examen för studie- och yrkesvägledare eller en pågående utbildning. 

Som person är du tydlig, trygg och pedagogisk. Du skapar förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du har förmågan att planera och organisera ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och effektfullt sätt. Du sätter självständigt och i samarbete med andra upp mål, organiserar resurser, följer upp och avslutar aktiviteter. 

Du formulerar dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska samt har hög digital kompetens. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i denna rekrytering då det är viktigt för oss att du passar in i vårt team. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. 

Start: Från den 1 december eller enligt överenskommelse. Du kommer att ha en relativt stor möjlighet att påverka ditt veckoschema tillsammans med oss för att eventuellt matcha ett annat uppdrag. 

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av annonsplatser.

Övrigt
